In the ST sample, fatigue striations in the crack propagation zone are relatively sparse/widely spaced at 180 MPa and wavy, widely spaced at 315 MPa, indicating a higher crack propagation rate than in 550-6 and 600-6 (b0042, figure_007).
In the ST sample, the fatigue crack path within large austenite grains is relatively straight, whereas aged samples show greater path tortuosity and microbranching (b0045, figure_009).
ST lacks intragranular κ-carbides and therefore exhibits the lowest fatigue strength (157.5 MPa at 10^7 cycles) among ST, 550-6 (162 MPa), 600-6 (175.5 MPa) and 650-6 (171 MPa) (b0035, b0066).
